hook: For Such a Time as This
text: A decree had gone out against her people, and Queen Esther was afraid to go to the king without being called. Then her cousin Mordecai sent her these words. For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father's house will perish. Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this? And Esther sent back her answer. If I perish, I perish.
title: For Such a Time as This (Esther 4)
